title: Generate reviewed proposals from Board edits
summary: Directly editing design.json or Swift source from the first Board release would bypass proposal evidence, ticket linkage, source audit and human review. Build an inspector that edits Board overrides and generates structured proposal deltas, with before/after preview and no source write-back.
acceptance_criteria: The Board inspector edits supported override properties through BoardCommands and never writes design.json or Swift source.
A proposal generator converts one or more transactions into a structured artifact with scope, rationale, evidence, ticket IDs, before/after values and affected objects.
The native review workspace can open the generated proposal and show its Board source context.
Before saving, the user sees a deterministic diff preview and validation errors for unsupported or stale targets.
Proposal generation preserves source evidence for tokens, components, views and repository artifacts when available.
Discarding or reverting Board edits does not delete previously saved proposal artifacts.
Tests cover property edits, multi-object transactions, stale imported truth and proposal round trips.

evidence.note: Current priorities include read-only change marking and repo-aware proposals.
Proposal-first authoring and separation from source truth are explicit.
Structured targets and evidence are already defined for native read-back.
Automatic mutation and source rewrite are explicitly absent.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.

trigger.source_ref: HumbleStudio Board architecture finding HS-BAR-008, requested by Jan.
